outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain schematic and western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.

Bar charts show a single value (% depletion, log2 elution abundance) per antibody with no indication these are averages requiring replicates/individual points shown, but if these represent averaged/quantified measurements across replicates, no individual data points or error bars are shown behind the bars.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D is a violin plot, which inherently displays the data distribution and is exempt from this check.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual data points (n=4 dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot; individual points are the data itself, so no additional overlay is needed.
Panel H is a scatterplot; individual points are the data itself, so no additional overlay is needed.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each point already represents an individual sample; no averaging is being displayed.
Panel J is a PCA scatterplot where each point already represents an individual sample; no averaging is being displayed.
